questions.question: Which cases are retained long term?
questions.proposal: Local QA remains existing 7/30 days. Formal drafts, approved deliveries and audit references each require explicit purpose/jurisdiction/Owner retention, no permanent default.

questions.question: Who may reopen?
questions.proposal: Keep Account custodian + Business Subject + current purpose/resource/member scope. A shared enterprise custody model is an independent future decision, not current support.

questions.question: Consultant leaves?
questions.proposal: Expiry/revocation blocks access immediately; no retained client-file access. New access requires separate client grant.

questions.question: Business revokes?
questions.proposal: Block new reads; preserve existing delivery/audit history pending approved retention/legal-hold decision. Never equate revoke with delete.

questions.question: Duplicate requests?
questions.proposal: Reuse native Account/Subject/request ID + digest reservation; replay same input, reject conflicting reuse. New formal grant/output pins need approved metadata version.

questions.question: Retention expires?
questions.proposal: Deny reopen first. No cleanup worker is authorized here; approved auditable deletion must respect record class, holds and encryption/backups.

questions.question: Loss/concurrency/recovery?
questions.proposal: Current same-request concurrency and fresh-process decrypt are verified. PENDING/orphan/key-loss cases stay explicit, not auto-COMPLETE; an Owner-reviewed reconciliation/recovery procedure is still required.
